fields.ambiguity: The 20-positive upstream set was resource-capped; it is not an intrinsic early-steady rule.
fields.exact_rule: 20 frozen positive targets inherited from Minimal Targeted Causal Replay; 18 matched nonpositive controls.

fields.ambiguity: No additional reset-effect or gain-magnitude threshold.

18 matched nonpositive samples; N_ORDER_1 frozen donor order is compared with the identical order after reset at its terminal-run boundary.

fields.ambiguity: Two of 20 positive targets failed early-steady and therefore had no reset branch.
fields.exact_rule: 18 positive reset samples; 18 control reset samples; 38 unique samples in the full instrumented experiment; 36 unique samples received a reset branch.

fields.ambiguity: Does not require the entire second half to be constant.

No explicit k; existence of a switch implies at least one pre-switch chunk.

fields.ambiguity: Terminal-run length can be shorter than second-half modal count.

fields.exact_rule: One-based first chunk of the final action's terminal equal-action run, equivalently last switch + 1.
At least one action switch; early first switch plus second-half modal steadiness. No required action identity.

fields.ambiguity: This is distinct from the looser second-half steadiness test.

Continue the same prompt forward and frozen action sequence; no prompt restart or prior-chunk replay; downstream chunks execute from reset fast state; generation unchanged.
